_readme: A CHIP SONG (SOUNDS 10/18/26, row [a new song every round], round two): played by engine/bohemia_chip_song.js. A bar is 16 steps at 120 BPM (a step is a sixteenth, 125 ms). In a voice's line a token is a note (C#5, Bb3) that holds through the dots after it, '-' stops it; the drums line names hits (k kick, s snare, h hat, o open hat, t tom). order is one pattern per bar. Four voices like the NES's four channels: the lead (a 50 percent pulse), the arpeggio (a 12.5 percent pulse), the bass (the triangle), the drums (the noise). env is the volume sequence, one of the 16 levels a frame at 60 Hz. draft:true until his vote.
title: THE LONG ROAD
key: E Dorian (the C sharp is the road's light; the B flat chord at bar 27 is the wrong sign, on purpose, and bar 21 is the stall)
